title: iris caucasica subsp. nezahatiae
intro: Iris caucasica subsp. nezahatiae, commonly known as a type of ornamental iris, is a flowering plant that belongs to the genus Iris. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with various health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects, which can help to soothe and protect the skin, as well as alleviate respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Iris caucasica subsp. nezahatiae include being a natural expectorant, which can aid in relieving coughs and congestion, and it also exhibits antispasmodic and anti-allergic properties. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
